comments: JN: LQ has pulled coordinates from MJ's field notebooks. However, she recorded a different coordinate for TEST 7-7 in her own field notebook. In her own field notebook, this coordinate is assigned to "POJA Nest 7". "POJA 7 TEST 7" is recorded as 71 17.31, 156 41.82 on a subsequent page. Given that LQ explictly distinguishes between these coordinates, I think this coordinate should be considered invalid.. Despite ostensibly being in the field together (and recording the same coordinate locations in their notebooks), somehow this coordinate diverges.  The same coordinate that LQ assigns to POJA 7-96, MJ assigns to TEST 7-7. However, LQ has a unique coordinate for TEST 7-7, while MJ does not record a coordinate for POJA 7-96. Interestingly, LQ's coordinate for TEST 7-7 is on the next page. I think the simpliest explanation is that MJ copied the data into her notebook from Lori's notebook, didn't see the TEST 7-7 coordinate on the next page, and incorrectly assumed that the "7" coordinate belonged to the "test" nest, not the real nest. Since Lori's notebook is unequivocal where MJ's is not, I am prioritizing the LQ coordinates. I am removing MJ's coordinates from this table.
